name: Asset Alchemist
title: Cinema Intelligence — Personal Movie Journal & Smart Discovery
subtitle: Cinema Intelligence — Movie Journal, Smart Discovery, Library Insights & Theater Control
features: Introduced a cinematic library overview with actual on-device movie, favorites, watchlist, and in-progress counts plus a featured title drawn from real saved movies.

Added custom display titles, private movie descriptions or notes, up to eight searchable tags, and optional release years to the existing Video Vault metadata, with safe length limits and text-only rendering.

Added instant combined search across local filenames, display titles, collections, notes, tags, and years, plus useful filters and sorts (unwatched, progress, favorites, watchlist, annotated, short clips, title, duration, size, recency).
Added metadata-only JSON catalog export that includes user-visible filenames and notes but never actual videos, posters, GIFs, account information, or storage blobs.
Added practical theater speed (0.75x–2x), optional repeat, and J/K/L keyboard shortcuts, all controlling the original Video Vault player without duplicate playback engines.
Improved poster-first cinema landing, title cards, detail editor, and responsive iPhone/PC browsing with reduced-motion styling and privacy guidance.
Preserved all 18 studios, original movie file bytes in OPFS/IndexedDB, v4 visual realms, user backgrounds, favorites, watchlist, Poster Forge, playback progress and offline rollback.
